crawl.title: Crawl Queue
crawl.description: Queue ORCIDs or DOIs to be analysed by the SDG engine and saved to the database.
crawl.process_desc: ORCID/DOI jobs run through the local SDG engine and the results are saved straight to the database. ORCIDs with many works are processed in steps and resume automatically.

cache.description: Move the SDG engine's cache files (cache/ folder) into the sangia_ecosystem database step by step, then archive the files that have been migrated.
cache.token_help: Enter the ADMIN_TOOL_TOKEN value from the server's .env file. The token is only kept in this browser tab.
cache.migrate_desc: Migrate cache files into database tables
cache.migrate_desc_full: Files are processed 25 per request until none remain, so hosting time limits are not hit. Data goes into the researchers, publications, publication_authors, journals and work_sdgs tables. Works without a DOI are skipped. Original files are not deleted.
cache.confirm_archive_msg: Files marked migrated/skipped are moved to cache/archive/. Pending or failed files are left alone. No files are deleted.

settings_api.saved_wis: WIS weights saved. They apply to the next impact calculation.

stats.summary: {{unverified}} accounts with unverified email · {{twofa}} accounts using 2FA · {{researchers}} researchers in the database

settings_api.config_desc: Server configuration status. Secret values are set in the .env file and never sent to the browser.
settings_api.env_note: To change API keys, SMTP, or OAuth, edit the .env file on the server (cPanel → File Manager). This is deliberate: a compromised admin account cannot read or replace server credentials.
settings_api.user_keys_note: Developer API keys (wz_…) are issued and revoked by wizdam-apis, not by this application.
settings_api.ui_note: The primary colour replaces indigo on buttons, links, and accents; the secondary colour replaces purple accents. The font is used when available on the visitor's device.
settings_api.maintenance_message: Message shown to visitors during maintenance
settings_api.session_timeout_help: Applies to sign-ins without "Remember me". "Remember me" sign-ins last 30 days.
settings_api.email_verify_note: While maintenance mode is on, only admins can use the application; the sign-in page stays open. Email verification can be forced off with REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION=false in .env.

cfg.feeEnabled: Require a listing fee for verification
cfg.feeInstructions_ph: E.g. Transfer to Bank … Acc. … in the name of …, then confirm on the listing page.

cfg.note: The fee applies to new listings. Listings posted by admins are verified automatically with no fee. An amount of 0 means free.
